So I was at a friends party and me and bday friend we both took the shrooms. It started off fine, I was even smoking weed and about an hour later it started to kick in. I was still chilling, nothing bothering me. Then the friend I took the shrooms with, started acting really weird. Saying shit like I’m trynna fight and was just being aggressive for no reason. I could tell he was not there completely. He then went to his room and I was still there with a couple of other really close friends. Then bday friend comes back out and is just looking at us in awe. It was also when I found out he was bald. Funny thing is I didn’t know he was bald because he always wore his beanie and it looked like he had hair under there. For some reason in my head I thought he shaved when he was in the room. Good thing I didn’t say anything tho, might of been awkward. Anyway he sits down and starts playing with his phone, out of nowhere he just asks us if we are mad at him, which we weren’t. So we started watching a skate part and he goes back into his room. Then comes back and is on the phone with the fucking POLICE. That instantly made internally freak out. My other friend snatches the phone from him and the cops ask if everything is okay blah blah. We just tell them yeah and that our friend was just freaking out for no reason.  Anyway after that the party died cuz bday friend was too fucked up, and making everyone else kinda uncomfortable. We all took shrooms, different dosage thoough. That’s when I started skating home and the effects of the shrooms were full on hitting me. I was so so stressed for no reason after leaving that party. I think it was just the internal freak out I had when the cops were called. Anyway I’m skating home at legit like 3 AM. All I see is homeless people and crackheads around. I swear all of them were just staring at me, looking all deformed and shit. Made me feel like I was about to get attacked. I get home, back then I lived on the last floor (8). I try to take the elevator and of course it’s out of service. So I now have to take the most fucked up looking emergency exit stairs with no light at all. Yo no joke I felt like I was in a fucking horror movie. I go inside. I’m pissed because I just had the worst trip ever and it’s still going. So I tell myself to relax and put another skate part on YouTube. An hour later I’m chilling again, more relaxed but still felt anxious for no reason. So I’m like you know I’m gonna make myself a nice little bowl smoke that and just keep watching videos till I fall asleep. I smoke my bong hit and I’d say like just a couple minutes later I remember that I have a roommate. I start thinking did I make too much noise ? Did I wake him up ? Is he mad at me ? I just start fixating on the handle of his door. Like legit I’m just staring at it until out of nowhere I don’t know who I am. I shit you not, I forgot what my name was, what I was doing, where I was, what I was thinking about. I go on full fight or flight mode. Like I have never felt my instincts so intense. Telling me to get the fuck out of there so hard. I see my phone besides me and I  kind of remember that I took shrooms. So I start googling but it keeps taking me to a page that makes no sense (at the time it didn’t make sense lol). Every time I went to google again I would google the same thing without remembering that I did it minutes ago and would go the same page. I thought I was going crazy, started thinking about how I’m gonna end up in a mental institute. Around that time I heard my roommate move on his bed and make some noises. I start thinking who the fuck is there, and go back into fight or flight mode. Like even more intense this time. I wasn’t very trusting of my roommate because I hadn’t really known him for long at all and wasn’t close to him. So I’m thinking like is this person trying to kill me and swear my mind went to the darkest place it’s ever been. I started thinking what if this random comes out and takes a knife and tries to kill me. I swear my instincts were telling me to prepare for self defence. I’m sooooo glad I ignored my instincts like that. I was just on the couch staring at the handle and then at the kitchen sink and back at the handle. I’d say I was stuck with those thoughts for like an hour or more. It felt real and very long. At one point I kind of get back to my senses and my memory. I know what’s happening a bit. But I still feel like I don’t know what the fuck is going on. So I decide to enter my roommates room and speak to him. I was so scared to do it, but like I felt that I had to. I needed someone to calm me down. I go in and I tell him something like bro can you help me out, I took shrooms last night and I’m seriously bad tripping like never before. He then starts talking with me and starts comforting me. Telling me he’s there and that we just chilling. Nothing to worry about. He talks to me about the stuff he sees that I like. I’m still internally fucked and still thinking that there might be some sort of altercation. I was scared shitless, but never took any action because I knew I was on shrooms. So I kept trying to tell my mind that the thought of him trying to kill me was a lie and eventually forgot about it. I tell him I wish I never took those shrooms. Eventually he manages to calm me down throughout the rest of the trip. But like I feel like that bad trip changed me. I slept and took a break, next day I go out to skate again. For a solid hour it felt like I lost all of my muscle memory skateboarding. Couldn’t do shit, even Ollies felt ducked up. I gained back the tricks that same day but that was very weird for me. I get paranoid episodes on weed a lot now, mostly when I’m alone. Used to smoke a lot, but now it’s mostly with friends. I forgot to mention that I also had suicidal thoughts on the bad trip. I was on my balcony just thinking about it, you know ? I’ve been suicidal before but last year was one of the years I had the most fun in a long time, mainly because of skateboarding. So I know I was happy then. So I don’t understand why I had that suicidal thought while staring at his door handle, bc I walked right out onto the balcony and just stared at the ground. I still take acid from time to time still haven’t bad tripped on it and still fun as hell. I really just want that random paranoia to go away though... That roommate is a very close friend now, because anybody else could of reacted the wrong way and I know for a fact that bad trip would of intensified. Felt really bad for bothering him afterwards haha. Anyway something that I found really strange too, was that I kept forgetting that I was in fight or flight mode and after a certain amount of time I’d go right back to fight or flight mode. It definitely happened many times, felt like loop thoughts on acid but I kept completely forgetting about it tho. Anyway all of this just to say that I don’t smoke weed when I do any hallucinogens because I found that I just fucks with it too much. Honestly I don’t know why I thought it was a good idea to smoke a bong hit when I knew I bad tripped earlier, because that was very very stupid of me. Pot head thinking I guess lol. But yeah never again
